You own ethsc/ingest.py, ethsc/store.py, ethsc/cluster.py, ethsc/cli.py and the NEW tests/test_origin_p13.py; change nothing else. ingest.py: add candidate_origins(receipts) next to discover_candidates (which stays as it is); ingest_block computes it once and passes origin=<origin> to every put_address it makes, in both the sequential and the workers path, and every alert dict gains the key origin. store.py: the addresses table gains origin TEXT (last column); on open, an addresses table without it gets ALTER TABLE addresses ADD COLUMN origin TEXT, the same way std_proxy is migrated -- and no UPDATE of old rows; put_address(address, code_id, block, origin=None); origins() -> dict, one SELECT, NULL read as 'unknown'. cluster.py: recheck_watchlist reads store.origins() once per call and sets origin on every alert; match_watchlist is unchanged. cli.py: the ALERT record gains a sixth field, the alert's origin, after the score; seed add --fetch stores with origin='fetched' (both put_address calls); listen and backfill gain --alert-on (choices created, seen, all; default all) and recheck gains --origin (choices created, seen, fetched, unknown; default none): filters on the printed lines only -- follow_chain still gets a sink, and stores and stats are untouched.
